items.caption: The tile is a standalone instance for the visualization and is separate from the data connection: it reads its values from a TibberGridReward instance and updates immediately when something changes there. If there is exactly one TibberGridReward instance, it is detected automatically as the source – only with several do you have to choose manually below.

Status colors, surface/text and font options adapt the tile to your visualization; without your own setting the tile follows the light/dark design of the device. The button “Reset colors & font to default” only changes the open form – it is saved only with “Apply changes”.

With “Show and edit automations (If->Then) on the tile” the tile manages the rules of the TibberGridReward source completely: “+ New rule” creates a rule, ✎ edits, the trash can deletes (with confirmation), the switch enables/disables. In the editor you can create any number of AND conditions and up to 6 actions per rule; for “Set value” the values defined in the profile/presentation are offered as a selection list where available. CAUTION: this really triggers the configured automations of the data source – therefore disabled by default.

Shows buttons on the tile itself to simulate available / charging / curtailment and to end the simulation again. CAUTION: this really triggers the configured automations of the data source – therefore also disabled by default.
Detailed documentation, examples and background: github.com/DG65/NRGTibberGridRewards.

elements.caption: Standalone tile for Tibber Grid Rewards. The tile fills the surface without a border and is separate from the data connection.

items.caption: Shows buttons on the tile itself to simulate available / charging / curtailment and to end the simulation again – without opening the instance configuration. CAUTION: this really triggers the EMS automations configured in the data source (real RequestAction commands)! Disabled by default because anyone with access to the WebFront could tap the buttons.

items.name: ShowSimControls
items.caption: Show simulation buttons on the tile

Shows the If->Then rules configured in the data source on the tile, with switch on/off per rule and its own rule editor (any number of AND conditions and actions per rule, including dependent selection lists for comparison and target values). CAUTION: through the editor you can really create/change/delete the EMS automations of the data source here – including actors such as the GoodWe storage and wallbox. Disabled by default because anyone with access to the WebFront could configure real actions with it.

items.name: ShowAutomations
items.caption: Show and edit automations (If->Then) on the tile
